inputs: a_n>0 for n>=0 and a_n=0 for n<0
every order-3 one-sided Toeplitz minor with consecutive rows is nonnegative
abstract_theorem.conclusion: every order-3 Toeplitz minor is nonnegative; together with the first two inputs, the sequence is PF3

proof_components.one_sided_boundaries: zero or a positive coefficient times a PF2 minor
proof_components.added_row: for d=c1+1, Delta_(i,j,d)^C=a_(c2-c1-1) times the PF2 minor on rows i,j and columns c0,c1
proof_components.adjacent_forward: Delta_(r,r+1,s) Delta_(r+1,r+2,d) = Delta_(r,r+1,r+2) Delta_(r+1,s,d) + Delta_(r,r+1,d) Delta_(r+1,r+2,s)
proof_components.adjacent_backward: Delta_(r,s-1,s) Delta_(s-2,s-1,d) = Delta_(r,s-2,s-1) Delta_(s-1,s,d) + Delta_(r,s-1,d) Delta_(s-2,s-1,s)
proof_components.general_induction: Delta_(r,u,s) Delta_(r+1,u,d) = Delta_(r,r+1,u) Delta_(u,s,d) + Delta_(r,u,d) Delta_(r+1,u,s)

Xi_instantiation.conclusion: the Xi coefficient sequence a_n=gamma_n/n! is PF3

scope_limitations: PF3 does not imply PF4 or PF-infinity
PF3 does not prove all Jensen-polynomial degrees
this is not a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis
